narrative:
## Board Submission Summary — Management P&L

## Key Decisions
• FY2026/27 management operating profit of GBP 203M submitted to the Partnership Board
• All three finance gates passed: profit tolerance, cost-to-sales and forecast accuracy
• Weekly rolling forecast adopted as the management standard

## Risk Factors
• Wage settlement and consumer demand downside of up to GBP 49M combined
• John Lewis foundational data still in progress for branch-level schedules

signals.title: PMIS still mastered in Excel
signals.excerpt: Management income statement, budget, forecast and cash flow live in spreadsheets. Reporting-line definitions exist only in workbooks, so every cycle re-reconciles the same numbers.

signals.title: Lessons from DCNRT
signals.excerpt: A prior finance data project did not deliver. Waitrose-first phasing on data already in Snowflake de-risks the next step.
